{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit sweater, slim fit, crew neck, hip length, deep burgundy #6D1F3A, merino wool
Midi skirt, A-line, mid-calf length, charcoal #36393F, wool crepe
Sheer tights, plain, black #121212, matte nylon
Tailored coat, single-breasted, knee length, camel #B08D6A, wool-blend with a soft textured weave
Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, black #1C1C1E, smooth leather
Small structured crossbody bag, black #1C1C1E, leather
Small hoop earrings, thin, gold tone #C9A24B, polished metal

This outfit sits in the neat range: a refined knit with a skirt and ankle boots feels polished enough for a theatre evening without being overdressed. The deep burgundy adds richness under artificial stage and foyer lighting, while the charcoal skirt keeps the look calm and grounded. The camel coat covers the cool autumn evening and can be handed to the cloakroom, leaving a clean silhouette for your seat. The low block heel keeps you comfortable through a 19:00 performance and the interval."}
